the-three-actions-at-a-glance.text: The sequence diagram follows Alice, the naming application, the registry and a resolver. Alice registers alice with address A; the application approves and mints the action token; the request waits with no NFT and no reservation; a folder proves absence and the registry mints the representative into the output holding address A. The resolver checks the key is Active and reads address A from the authenticated output. Alice changes the address to B; the application spends the output and creates a successor with the same NFT, with no registry request, mint or burn.

register.text: Alice's proposal is approved and its action token minted; the pending request has no NFT. A folder later proves absence, sets Active and mints the representative into the certified output. Prior approval never reserved Alice's place.

resolve.text: A resolver establishes the key is Active, authenticates the representative, finds the current application UTxO and reads the address from its datum. A pending terminal request, an absent key and an Over key all yield no live address.

change-address.text: The application approves changing A to B, spends the current UTxO and requires a successor with the same representative and new datum. The registry stays Active. The table summarizes register, resolve and change address by registry operation and representative movement.
